name: NIST Working Drafts for PQC Updates to PIV Standards
known_limitations: The materials are preliminary working drafts, not formal public drafts or final standards. They identify proposed PIV changes but do not prove product support, agency implementation, credential issuance, interoperability, or completed migration.
source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
automation_notes: Track formal drafts, comment disposition, final SP 800-73 and SP 800-78 revisions, vendor implementations, validation, agency pilots, credential issuance, and migration outcomes.
notes: Phase 55N standards-implementation record. The working approach proposes dual-stack PIV support for ML-DSA and ML-KEM with backward-compatible new key references, certificate containers, and data objects.
